# glinet_wireguard_interface (Resource)

Manage one OpenWrt WireGuard interface. The private key is a write-only argument; it is never stored in plan or state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glinet_wireguard_interface" "wg0" {
  name           = "wg0"
  addresses      = ["10.8.0.1/24"]
  listen_port    = 51820
  private_key_wo = var.wireguard_private_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) WireGuard interface name, such as `wg0`.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `addresses` (Set of String) Interface addresses in CIDR notation.
- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the interface is enabled.
- `fwmark` (String) Optional firewall mark.
- `listen_port` (Number) UDP listen port.
- `mtu` (Number) Optional MTU; zero leaves the firmware default.
- `no_host_route` (Boolean) Do not add the host route.
- `private_key_version` (Number) Client-managed key generation. Increase it when rotating `private_key_wo`.
- `private_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only WireGuard private key.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
